components.basis: Side-by-side longtable 'First-order proof systems side by side' (label tab:p02-fol-proof-systems, section sec:p02-fol-calculi-comparison) with one row each for Hilbert (191-208), Natural deduction (209-218), LK (219-235) and Tableau (236-244). Each row's scope column states its language (equality-free or identity-bearing) and registry sheet, so no system or domain is silently changed; the identity-tableau extension is located at 162-169. The table is the current surface on the route (parts/p02.tex 89); the same labels in the off-route parts/p02/first-order-calculi.tex were not used.

The table's columns are 'Rule families', 'Exact side conditions' and 'Adequacy evidence' (182). Rules: A1-A3, forall1/forall2/exists1, MP, Gen, exists E (191-192); propositional I/E, RAA, forall/exists I/E, alpha, =I/E (209-210); initials, structural and propositional rules, Cut, Mix, quantifier rules, equality reflexivity and left replacement (219-221); propositional, gamma, delta expansions and closure (236-237). Side conditions: capture-avoiding substitution, forall2 and exists E freshness, Gen dependency (192-195); forall I and exists E eigenvariable conditions, nonvacuous discharge (211-214); forall R / exists L eigenvariable, forall L / exists R substitution, Mix multiplicities (221-224); finite equality-free root, gamma fairness, delta least fresh parameter (237-240). Adequacy theorems by label: thm:p02-hfa-soundness/adequacy (HFA 58-63, 139-160); thm:fol-soundness, thm:fol-completeness, cor:fol-completeness-countable; thm:fol-lk-soundness, thm:p07-eqlk-soundness, thm:p07-canonical-lk-completeness, thm:p07-eqlk-completeness, the disclosed sketch thm:fol-lk-completeness; thm:p02-fol-tableau-adequacy and thm:p02-w02-p02-014-fol-semidecision (196-206, 214-217, 224-233, 240-243). Every cited label is declared on the active route. Accuracy observation (not a coverage gap under the acceptance clause): the ND side-condition cell does not restate the alpha rule's proviso phi =_alpha psi, which is stated on the row's named registry sheet (registry/calculi/nd-fol.tex rule:nd-fol-alpha).
